A '''cantina''' operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phorliss]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], using the alias "Karrinna Jansih", worked as a serving girl there for a time.
